rules.inferred_target_transition: Recipe content is inference unless a source record explicitly contains the target transition.
rules.status_preservation: Copy legacy decision/status; never upgrade through re-encoding.
rules.supplemental_research: Internal/research transitions are included only as explicitly classified supplemental records.

target_transition_recipes: An offline conflict occurs; operator must reconstruct causal/version/property evidence and choose a safe resolution.
A recurring CSV/XLSX version arrives; recipient must decide accept, reject, or request correction based on downstream semantic impact.
GitHub review routing without premature notification
Review eligibility is satisfied; required reviewer routing occurs only at the correct workflow point.
Related exports arrive; discrepancies become an actionable reconciliation result.
Two file versions exist; relevant structural/row/cell changes become visible before downstream use.
An import-bound file arrives; invalid/risky structure or values are detected or repaired before import.
An untrusted execution request starts; execution remains inside an isolated bounded runtime.
A capability request reaches authorization; policy/relation decision is explicit before effect.
A browser task is triggered; required browser actions execute reproducibly.
An agent action completes; the effect is independently reconstructable and verifiable.
A client needs a capability; server metadata/schema/conformance becomes discoverable and inspectable.
A field operator works without connectivity; data is captured offline and synchronized later.
Inventory/export state reaches reorder review; reorder candidates become actionable.
An order arrives through DM/WhatsApp/phone; it becomes a validated and tracked order record.
